_doc: Ruined outposts (automation/outposts.gd). Each district has 3-4 at fixed seeded spots on the frontier ring. Repair needs the outpost's hex mostly clean (clean_needed = removed fraction) and costs cubes + building stock; each repair in a district costs repair_growth x more. A repaired outpost is a working scale (same value logic as the main depot + sell_bonus of its level), a Drip refill point and an idle spot for robots. Level 2 = Big Skip (bigger pad, better price), level 3 = Recharge Pad (robots passing within charge_radius run charge_mult faster for charge_s seconds).

levels.name: Weigh Station
levels.desc: A working scale and skip on the frontier. Haul Bugs deliver to the nearest scale.

levels.name: Big Skip
levels.desc: A bigger skip and a wider, faster scale plate. Bales here sell for 15% more.

levels.name: Recharge Pad
levels.desc: A charging pad. Robots passing over it run 40% faster for 25 s.
